name: COKIQ
tagline: Cookie consent for Indian websites, with a DPDP Act profile
maker_comment_excerpt: Hi Product Hunt, I'm Reji, maker of COKIQ (from Hostao). We built COKIQ for Indian site owners getting ready for the DPDP Act, who need to know one thing first: what does my site load before a visitor says yes? COKIQ scans the page, holds trackers until a visitor chooses, and keeps dated consent records you can export. It has an India DPDP Act banner profile, prices in INR and a free plan for one site. EU/UK and US profiles are included too. Try the free checker on your own site (no sign-up) and
